overall: The AG found the Everett School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by keeping February 2 executive session minutes that only listed motions and votes, ordering revised minutes and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the minutes of the February 2 executive session (litigation strategy on Level III grievances) were insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the minutes do not adequately capture the substance of the discussions that occurred so that a member of the public who did not attend the meeting could read the minutes and have an understanding of what occurred.

remedy: Revise the February 2 executive session minutes and certify to the AG's office within 60 days of the letter that it has done so.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee to revise the February 2 executive session meeting minutes and to certify to this office within sixty (60) days of the date of this letter that it has done so.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
